name: 全息艺术工坊

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. A neighborhood holographic art workshop: asymmetrical stepped block volumes, large display window with an abstract solid sculpture, purple and cyan frame accents, workshop entrance and small skylight. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately

visualReview.notes: 展示窗、阶梯屋顶与植被完整；窗内艺术细节简化。
